mapper.select: INSERT INTO disputes (order_id, opener_id, reason, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{openerId}, #{reason}, #{status}) RETURNING id
SELECT * FROM disputes WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'OPEN'
SELECT * FROM disputes WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE disputes SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolution = #{resolution}, resolution_note = #{note}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND s.owner_id = #{ownerId}
